notes: SDSS J090745.0+024507 is the only individually named star. At T:p3-b5 the paper also refers to about 20 known HVSs with speeds sufficient to escape the Galaxy, but it does not give their individual identifiers, so they cannot be rostered as separate stars. The S-star population at T:p3-b6 is described as bound to Sgr A*, not as Galactic-unbound candidates. The named star is categorized as follow_up because the paper attributes its discovery to Brown et al. (2005) and uses it as a known HVS example.

SDSS J090745.0+024507: The star's coordinates are encoded in its designation (SDSS J090745.0+024507), but the paper does not report numerical right ascension or declination values, so none are extracted.
